kb_articles.title: Bulk insert constraint violation on staging tables during data load
kb_articles.content: A constraint violation during the bulk insert into a staging table such as STG_CUSTOMER aborts the load step. Check the source extract for duplicate keys before loading.

kb_articles.title: Rounding difference on decimal amount columns during compare
kb_articles.content: Banker's rounding in C# differs from COBOL half-up rounding and produces a compare mismatch on decimal amount columns.
